text.zh_cn:
这把剑低语着战斗的诀窍。
- 攻击冷却条满时出手，伤害最高
- 剑的横扫可同时命中多个目标
- 锋利、火焰附加等附魔可经 [item:minecraft:anvil] 转移
> 犹豫，就会败北。
text.en_us:
This blade whispers the art of war.
- Strike when the cooldown bar is full for peak damage
- Sword sweeps hit multiple foes at once
- Sharpness and fire aspect transfer via [item:minecraft:anvil]
> Hesitation is defeat.
